trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 135-degree wide V-shaped central notch with a shallow vertical depth relative to the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The continuous boundary exhibits low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations; the left lobe edge is relatively smooth, while the right lobe edge shows increasing irregularity toward the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory for both lobes, with the left lobe exhibiting a more uniform upward sweep to a rounded tip compared to the more truncated right lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal extremity of the right fluke lobe displays a highly irregular, jagged termination and distinct protruding pixel clusters, indicating significant tissue loss or traumatic amputation at the tip.
